model.name: ONE VIEW BUS by elimination — no subscriber paints a pushed copy; detail is a ref to re-derive (realtime-MVC single-source, T37.25)
model.description: ONE VIEW BUS by ELIMINATION, not reconciliation: retire every SECOND source of a shared model-truth around the already-unified bus instance, in 4 bounded increments. THE HAZARD (the whole design's property): a SUBSCRIBER that RENDERS a field VALUE carried in an event.detail (a pushed COPY that can go stale) instead of using detail ONLY as a ref/signal to RE-DERIVE from the authoritative source. Measured second-sources: (1) the root adapter ../ViewBus.ts (24-line model-carrying API over the SAME instance, TWO import paths, 4 User-surfaces, RawBinClient flags it as DRY debt); (2) parallel window.dispatchEvent(CustomEvent('rb-*')) model-truth channels (rb-avatar-updated x6, rb-avatar-changed) whose subscribers PAINT detail values. Cure = eliminate the copy: subscribe-on-render + re-derive-live, and gate the CONSUMER PROPERTY (a detail is a ref only) so the KEEP set FALLS OUT of the property and a NEW model-carrying event cannot hide (no hand-list — the check:pin-single-source actor-blocklist failure mode).

A mid-slice wall costs ONE increment, not the slice. Expert builds increment-by-increment on build-go.
model.metaFinding: ★ ELIMINATION, NOT RECONCILIATION: retire the second definition, never synchronize it (an adapter kept-in-step IS the reconciliation to eliminate). ★ The gate asserts the HAZARD (a subscriber painting a pushed copy), NOT an event KEEP-list — a hand-list is exactly how check:pin-single-source shipped GREEN over Tron's defect. The KEEP set FALLS OUT of the consumer-property; a new model-carrying event cannot hide by construction. ★ POST-BROADCAST is load-bearing timing: an initial-load check false-passes. acceptanceCriteria.text: ★ THE CONSUMER PROPERTY (the whole cure, gate asserts THIS not an event list): NO subscriber may PAINT event.detail.<modelValue>; a CustomEvent detail may be consumed ONLY as a ref/target/signal (re-derive/re-fetch keyed by it), never as the model itself. ⇒ the KEEP set FALLS OUT of the property (orchestration events carry no painted value = nothing to fix), NEVER enumerated. A NEW model-carrying event CANNOT hide: paints its detail value => RED; uses only a ref => genuinely orchestration. Subsumes the avatar case (rb-avatar-updated subscribers re-derive the avatar from the authoritative profile on the signal, NOT paint detail.url). Sharper than a hand-classification (rb-model-resynced {refs, no painted value} = genuine orchestration, not folded). ★ EXTENDED 2026-08-24 (architect 954dbf994, promotion): the property GENERALIZES from 'no CLIENT subscriber paints event.detail.<value>' to ANY CONSUMER (client render OR SERVER endpoint) READS the shared truth and NEVER RE-PRODUCES it — a server endpoint that derives current-role OR calls slotsFrom with its OWN/missing inputs is the SAME hazard (a 2nd source), enforced across BOTH trees (src/ts server AND src/public/ts client). This closes the #3 hole (/api/trace/children?mode=trace recomputed a disagreeing slots).

acceptanceCriteria.text: RUNTIME R37.12 @390 (CONSUMER-vs-CONSUMER, POST-BROADCAST): after a mutation BROADCAST, two CONSUMERS of the same ref render the SAME value on the RENDERED artifact (e.g. displayName in ProfileSheet DOM == rb-member-badge DOM == RoomBrowser DOM), @390 real-WebKit. NOT view-vs-model. NOT at initial load (a load-time variant must be PROVEN to false-pass and is rejected — the state-under-test is post-broadcast). ★ RED BASELINE (live known-positive shape): a consumer holding a STORED STALE copy renders a DIFFERENT value post-broadcast -> the gate MUST RED. Prove the gate can fail on that shape before trusting a GREEN. ★ EXTENDED (Tron's real sequence): the @390 gate MUST run the OPEN-BEFORE-then-broadcast sequence (drawer open BEFORE the Set-as-Current broadcast = Tron's actual tap), NOT open-AFTER. The derive-at-render green false-greened precisely because it was measured on the clean OPEN-AFTER sequence; #3's endpoint (/api/trace/children) fires in the OPEN-BEFORE flow, where the bar's slots DISAGREES with the pin's slots.current post-broadcast. R37.24's POST-BROADCAST + CONSUMER-vs-CONSUMER property catches #3 by construction on this sequence.
